statement: The apparatus-release-consolidation budget script passes the repository's own guideline checkers -- eslint, the literal-owner audit and the ambient-intrinsic audit -- on its own changed path, and a test measures it against a fixture tree so the epic's doneWhen probe has a witness that is not the real repository. Adapting the script changes how values are named and how intrinsics are reached; it changes no budget number and no measured value.

constraints.statement: No budget number changes. Extracting a value to a named constant is permitted; altering the value it holds, the comparator it is read by, or the row it gates is not.

The adapted script reports the same rows, the same values and the same unmet count against the same tree as the sealed script did. A measurement that moves is a defect in the adaptation, never a new budget.
The guideline checkers are satisfied by changing this script, never by raising a ratchet baseline, adding a baseline entry, or excluding the path from a checker (R23).
The test measures a constructed fixture tree it owns, so the witness does not move when the real repository's counts move.
